home.title: WG Easy Plane
home.description: Manage wg-easy nodes and scoped automation access from this control plane.

auth.setupDescription: This is the only administrator account for this panel.
auth.loginDescription: Use the administrator credentials configured on first run.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth.requestFailed: The panel could not complete the authentication request.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Connect wg-easy 15.4.0 instances and monitor their compatibility status.
nodes.deleteDescription: Delete {name}? This only removes the local node and never deletes remote clients.
nodes.insecureGlobalDescription: At least one node accepts an unverified TLS certificate. Review this exception regularly.
nodes.compatibilityGlobalDescription: At least one node has an unsupported wg-easy version or incompatible API. Its last safe inventory remains available.
nodes.insecureFormDescription: Use this only for a node you control. A network attacker could impersonate the node.
nodes.testNoVersion: No compatible wg-easy version could be confirmed.

fields.name: Node name
fields.hostHint: Hostname or IP only, without scheme, path, or port.
fields.credentialEditHint: Leave blank to retain the encrypted stored value.

failures.create: The node could not be added. Check for duplicate names or endpoints.
failures.update: The node could not be updated.
failures.test: The connection test could not be completed.
failures.sync: The client inventory could not be synchronized.
failures.delete: The node could not be deleted. Remove its managed placements first.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Review clients discovered on each node. Matching names remain separate until explicitly adopted.
clients.loadFailure: The discovered client inventory could not be loaded.
clients.empty: No clients have been discovered. Synchronize a healthy node first.
clients.managedDescription: Create one logical client across selected nodes and track each placement independently.
clients.managedEmpty: No managed clients have been created.
clients.resolveDescription: Creation timed out, so an automatic retry could create a duplicate. Link a synchronized candidate or cancel only the local placement.
clients.noCandidates: No unlinked same-name candidate was found. Synchronize the node and check again.

advanced.title: Advanced settings · {node}
advanced.loadFailure: The validated placement state could not be loaded. Synchronize the node and try again.
advanced.updateFailure: The desired settings are saved, but the node did not confirm the update. Retry from the placement actions.
advanced.compatibilityDescription: This pinned release supports jC, jMin, jMax and i1–i5. Newer AWG 3.0/3.1 padding, rekey, cookie and handshake controls are not present in its update API and are intentionally not sent.

adoption.title: Adopt discovered clients
adoption.description: Select at most one current remote client per node. Adoption creates local management records and does not mutate any node.

delivery.title: Connection QR · {label}
delivery.description: Scan this live image with the matching WireGuard client. It is not stored by the panel.

drift.title: Placement state · {node}
drift.loadFailure: The placement state could not be loaded. Synchronize the node and try again.
drift.description: Remote values differ from the saved desired state. Choose explicitly which state should win.
drift.missingDescription: A complete successful sync confirmed that this remote client is missing. Recreating it allocates a new remote client.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Create revocable credentials with only the scopes your automation needs.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.expirationHint: Optional. Uses your local time and is stored as UTC.
tokens.secretDescription: This complete secret is shown only once. It cannot be recovered after dismissal or reload.
tokens.copyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the token manually.
tokens.empty: No API tokens have been created.
tokens.revokeDescription: Revoke {name}? Requests using it will fail immediately.

failures.load: API tokens could not be loaded.
failures.create: The API token could not be created. Check the fields and try again.
failures.revoke: The API token could not be revoked. Try again.
